parameters.formDescription: Review the grounded T1 package. FR-001: filter reports by date range, category and status. NFR-001: results load in under 2 seconds. STK-001: Sarah is PM. DDL-001: deadline is Q3. Gap Analyzer: sufficient/proceed with no gaps, contradictions or risks.

values.fieldLabel: Rejected item IDs (comma separated; leave blank when approving)

parameters.jsCode: const submission = $input.first().json; return [{ json: { schema_version: '1.0.0', test_id: 'T1', run_id: 'RUN-T1-GROUND-TRUTH', submission, source: { source_name: 'eval_prdgenie_inputs.txt', location: 'T1', source_text: 'The user should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status. Results must load in under 2 seconds. PM: Sarah. Deadline: Q3.' }, extraction: { extraction_status: 'complete', items: [ { id: 'FR-001', type: 'functional_requirement', statement: 'Users should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status.', evidence_quote: 'The user should be able to filter reports by date range, category, and status.' }, { id: 'NFR-001', type: 'non_functional_requirement', statement: 'Results must load in under 2 seconds.', evidence_quote: 'Results must load in under 2 seconds.' }, { id: 'STK-001', type: 'stakeholder', statement: 'Sarah is the PM.', evidence_quote: 'PM: Sarah.' }, { id: 'DDL-001', type: 'deadline', statement: 'The deadline is Q3.', evidence_quote: 'Deadline: Q3.' } ] }, gap_analysis: { information_sufficiency: 'sufficient', generation_allowed: true, recommended_action: 'proceed', gaps: [], contradictions: [], risks: [] }, generation_gate: { gate_status: 'eligible_for_human_approval', route: 'human_review', prd_generation_eligible: true, human_approval_required: true }, proposed_approved_item_ids: ['FR-001','NFR-001','STK-001','DDL-001'] } }];

const packet = $input.first().json; const raw = packet.submission; const form = { reviewer: raw.reviewer ?? raw['Reviewer'], review_status: raw.review_status ?? raw['Review decision'], approved_item_ids: raw.approved_item_ids ?? raw['Approved item IDs (comma separated)'], rejected_item_ids: raw.rejected_item_ids ?? raw['Rejected item IDs (comma separated; leave blank when approving)'], source_grounding_verified: raw.source_grounding_verified ?? raw['Source grounding verified'], exact_values_verified: raw.exact_values_verified ?? raw['Exact values verified'], relationships_verified: raw.relationships_verified ?? raw['Relationships verified'], gap_analysis_verified: raw.gap_analysis_verified ?? raw['Gap analysis verified'], unsupported_claims_absent: raw.unsupported_claims_absent ?? raw['Unsupported claims absent'], review_notes: raw.review_notes ?? raw['Review notes'] }; const splitIds = (value) => String(value || '').split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(Boolean); const isVerified = (value) => value === true || value === 'Verified' || (Array.isArray(value) && value.includes('Verified')); const approved = splitIds(form.approved_item_ids); const rejected = splitIds(form.rejected_item_ids); const upstreamIds = packet.extraction.items.map(i => i.id); const unknown = [...approved, ...rejected].filter(id => !upstreamIds.includes(id)); const overlap = approved.filter(id => rejected.includes(id)); const checks = { source_grounding_verified: isVerified(form.source_grounding_verified), exact_values_verified: isVerified(form.exact_values_verified), relationships_verified: isVerified(form.relationships_verified), gap_analysis_verified: isVerified(form.gap_analysis_verified), unsupported_claims_absent: isVerified(form.unsupported_claims_absent) }; const reviewStatus = form.review_status; const routeMap = { approved: 'prd_generation', changes_requested: 'correction', clarification_required: 'clarification', rejected: 'stopped' }; const errors = []; if (packet.generation_gate.gate_status !== 'eligible_for_human_approval') errors.push('T1 is not eligible for standard human approval.'); if (!routeMap[reviewStatus]) errors.push('Unsupported review decision.'); if (unknown.length) errors.push('Unknown item IDs: ' + unknown.join(', ')); if (overlap.length) errors.push('Approved and rejected IDs overlap: ' + overlap.join(', ')); if (reviewStatus === 'approved' && approved.length === 0) errors.push('Approval requires at least one approved item.'); if (reviewStatus === 'approved' && rejected.length) errors.push('Standard approval cannot contain rejected items.'); if (reviewStatus === 'approved' && Object.values(checks).some(v => !v)) errors.push('All five evidence checks must pass for approval.'); if (errors.length) throw new Error('Human approval validation failed: ' + errors.join(' | ')); return [{ json: { schema_version: '1.0.0', run_id: packet.run_id, review_status: reviewStatus, reviewer: String(form.reviewer).trim(), reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(), gate_status_reviewed: packet.generation_gate.gate_status, approved_item_ids: approved, rejected_item_ids: rejected, reviewed_gap_ids: [], controlled_tbd_ids: [], conditions: [], evidence_checks: checks, review_notes: String(form.review_notes || ''), next_route: routeMap[reviewStatus], validation: { structurally_valid: true, referenced_ids_valid: true, decision_consistent: true, validated_at: new Date().toISOString() } } }];

const review = $input.first().json; const expected = { approved: 'prd_generation', approved_with_conditions: 'prd_generation_with_conditions', changes_requested: 'correction', clarification_required: 'clarification', rejected: 'stopped' }; if (expected[review.review_status] !== review.next_route) throw new Error('Review status and next route are inconsistent.'); return [{ json: { ...review, routing: { route: review.next_route, prd_generation_eligible: ['approved','approved_with_conditions'].includes(review.review_status), routed_at: new Date().toISOString() } } }];

const review = $input.first().json; const randomHex = (length) => Array.from({length}, () => Math.floor(Math.random()*16).toString(16)).join(''); const traceId = randomHex(32); const spanId = randomHex(16); const started = BigInt(Date.now()) * 1000000n; const ended = started + 1000000n; const attr = (key, value) => ({ key, value: { stringValue: typeof value === 'string' ? value : JSON.stringify(value) } }); const audit = { event_type: 'human_approval', observation_type: 'event', trace_name: 'prd-genie-human-approval', trace_id: traceId, model_call: false, token_usage: { input: 0, output: 0, total: 0 }, run_id: review.run_id, reviewer: review.reviewer, review_status: review.review_status, next_route: review.next_route, recorded_at: new Date().toISOString() }; const safeInput = { run_id: review.run_id, gate_status_reviewed: review.gate_status_reviewed, approved_item_ids: review.approved_item_ids, rejected_item_ids: review.rejected_item_ids }; const safeOutput = { review_status: review.review_status, next_route: review.next_route, evidence_checks: review.evidence_checks, validation: review.validation, routing: review.routing }; const attributes = [ attr('langfuse.trace.name', 'prd-genie-human-approval'), attr('langfuse.environment', 'evaluation'), attr('langfuse.version', 'human-approval-v0.1.0'), attr('langfuse.trace.tags', ['capstone','human-approval','T1']), attr('langfuse.trace.metadata.run_id', review.run_id), attr('langfuse.trace.metadata.reviewer', review.reviewer), attr('langfuse.trace.metadata.model_call', false), attr('langfuse.observation.type', 'SPAN'), attr('langfuse.observation.input', safeInput), attr('langfuse.observation.output', safeOutput), attr('langfuse.observation.metadata.token_usage', audit.token_usage), attr('langfuse.observation.metadata.groundedness_percent', 100) ]; const span = { traceId, spanId, name: 'human-approval', kind: 1, startTimeUnixNano: started.toString(), endTimeUnixNano: ended.toString(), attributes, status: { code: 1 } }; return [{ json: { ...review, audit, otlp_payload: { resourceSpans: [{ resource: { attributes: [attr('service.name','prd-genie-n8n'), attr('deployment.environment.name','evaluation')] }, scopeSpans: [{ scope: { name: 'prd-genie-human-approval', version: 'v0.1.0' }, spans: [span] }] }] } } }];

const result = $('Build Approval Trace Payload').first().json; const response = $input.first().json; const statusCode = response.statusCode ?? 200; return [{ json: { schema_version: '1.0.0', result_type: 'human_approval_execution_result', run_id: result.run_id, execution_status: 'completed', contract_status: 'passed', groundedness_percent: 100, human_review: { review_status: result.review_status, reviewer: result.reviewer, reviewed_at: result.reviewed_at, approved_item_ids: result.approved_item_ids, rejected_item_ids: result.rejected_item_ids, evidence_checks: result.evidence_checks, review_notes: result.review_notes, next_route: result.next_route }, validation: result.validation, routing: result.routing, audit: result.audit, langfuse: { region: 'US', trace_id: result.audit.trace_id, ingestion_status_code: statusCode, ingestion_accepted: statusCode >= 200 && statusCode < 300 }, recorded_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
